# MiniMax Pricing 2026: Hailuo Video, API, and Coding Plans Explained
By [Lenka Vojtechova](https://felloai.com/author/lenka-vojtechova/)  ·  Updated October 17, 2026  ·  12 min read

[AI Pricing](https://felloai.com/tag/ai-pricing/) [Fello AI](https://felloai.com/tag/fello-ai/) [MiniMax](https://felloai.com/tag/minimax/)

![MiniMax Pricing 2026 thumbnail featuring bold white and yellow text reading “MiniMax Pricing 2026” and “Hailuo, API & Coding Plans,” alongside a glowing 3D MiniMax logo in its red, orange, yellow, pink, and purple brand colors.](https://felloai.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/minimax-pricing-1536x864-hero.webp)

**MiniMax pricing** covers three separate products under one brand, which is why it confuses people. The **Hailuo AI** video generator runs from a **free** tier up to **$199.99/month**. The **MiniMax API** bills its flagship **MiniMax M3** at **$0.30 input and $1.20 output per million tokens**. The developer subscription, now called the **M Plan** after it replaced the old Token Plan, starts at **$22/month**. Every figure below was re-checked against MiniMax’s own pages on October 17, 2026.

The naming is the first hurdle. **Hailuo AI** is MiniMax’s consumer video app, **MiniMax** is the company and its API brand, and searches like “hailuo minimax pricing” mix the two together. This guide separates all three so you can find your exact plan, see what a single video or a million tokens actually costs, and decide which tier is worth paying for. Prices here move often, so treat every figure as a starting point and confirm at the source before you buy.

## The Key Takeaways
- **Hailuo AI video plans** run from a **free** tier to **$199.99/month** (Max), with paid plans listing at **$14.99 to $199.99** and a limited-time promo cutting the entry Standard tier to **$7.99/month**.
- Paid plans include **1,000 to 20,000 monthly credits**, enough for **roughly 40 to 900 videos** at economical settings; credits reset monthly and do not roll over.
- The **MiniMax API** bills **MiniMax M3** and **M2.7** at **$0.30/$1.20 per million tokens**; M3 prompts above 512K tokens cost **$0.60/$2.40**. OpenRouter’s discount has shrunk to a few cents, with **M2.5** at **$0.27/$0.95**.
- The developer **M Plan**, which replaced the Token Plan, costs **$22/month** (Go), **$55/month** (Explore) or **$132/month** (Build). Annual billing gives **2 months free**, and only Explore and Build include the **H3** video model.
- All paid Hailuo plans **remove the watermark**, add **commercial use rights**, and bundle MiniMax’s own **H3** video model with other labs’ models like **Veo 3.1** and **Nano Banana Pro**. The plan page still lists **Sora 2**, but OpenAI has shut Sora down.

## How Much Does MiniMax Cost? The Short Answer
From the publisher

Every AI model in one app

Fello AI puts GPT-6, Claude 5.5, Gemini 4 Argon, Grok 4.7 and more in one native Mac and iPhone app.

[Download now!](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6447705369?ct=felloai-web-banner-app-promo-default)

From the publisher

Stop tab-hopping between AI apps

Ask ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini the same question in one window and keep the best answer. On Mac, iPhone and iPad.

[Try it free](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6447705369?ct=felloai-web-banner-app-promo-outcome)

MiniMax sells three things, and each is priced on its own logic. The **Hailuo AI** video generator uses monthly credit subscriptions aimed at creators, from **free** up to **$199.99/month**. The **MiniMax API** is pay-as-you-go per token for developers, with **MiniMax M3** at **$0.30/$1.20 per million tokens** on the official sheet. The **M Plan**, which replaced the Token Plan (also sold as the Coding Plan), is a flat developer subscription from **$22/month** that swaps metered billing for shared usage windows.

If you just want to make AI videos, you want Hailuo. If you are wiring MiniMax models into your own software, you want the API or the M Plan. Hailuo also ranks among the [**best free AI video generators**](https://felloai.com/best-free-ai-video-generators/), so you can start without paying anything.

## Hailuo AI Pricing: Video Plans and Credits
Hailuo AI runs on credits. Every subscription hands you a monthly credit pool, and each video spends credits based on its resolution, length, and model. A short 768p clip is the cheapest output, while higher resolutions and longer durations burn through credits faster, so the video counts below assume the most economical settings. Credits reset each month and unused ones expire, which matters a lot when you pick a tier.

Here are the current Hailuo plans, re-checked on October 17, 2026 on the official [**Hailuo subscription page**](https://hailuoai.video/subscribe). Prices and credit counts have not changed since June. The list prices below reflect the standard monthly rate; a running limited-time promotion still discounts the three lower tiers, and the page shows the promo price you actually pay at checkout.

| Plan | List / month | Current promo | Monthly credits | Videos/month (approx) |
|-|-|-|-|-|
| **Free** | **$0** | N/A | Trial credits | Trial only |
| **Standard** | **$14.99** | **$7.99** | 1,000 | ~40 |
| **Pro** | **$54.99** | **$24.99** | 4,500 | ~180 |
| **Master** | **$94.99** | **$63.99** | 10,000 | ~400 |
| **Ultra** | **$124.99** | No promo | 12,000 | ~480 |
| **Max** | **$199.99** | No promo | 20,000 | ~900 |

### Hailuo Free and Standard ($7.99 to $14.99)
The **Free** plan is fine for trying things out, but it gives you limited trial credits, keeps the watermark, restricts you to Hailuo’s own models, and sits at the lowest queue priority. The **Standard** plan lists at **$14.99/month** and is currently discounted to **$7.99** on a limited-time promo that the company says reverts to $14.99 once it ends. It includes **1,000 credits**, around **40 six-second 768p videos** or about a dozen 1080p clips, removes the watermark, and adds commercial rights, though it caps video length at six seconds and runs tasks one at a time.

### Hailuo Pro and Master ($24.99 to $94.99)
The **Pro** plan lists at **$54.99/month**, currently **$24.99** on promo, and bumps you to **4,500 credits**, roughly **180 economical videos**, plus ten-second 1080p output and two clips rendering in parallel. The **Master** plan lists at **$94.99/month**, currently **$63.99**, with **10,000 credits** and around **400 videos**. This is the band most regular creators land on, since 4,500 to 10,000 credits is enough to publish a steady stream of clips without rationing every generation.

### Hailuo Ultra and Max ($124.99 to $199.99)
The **Ultra** plan costs **$124.99/month** for **12,000 credits**, about **480 videos**, and adds unlimited use of the older Hailuo 01 model at no credit cost. The **Max** plan, at **$199.99/month** for **20,000 credits** and roughly **900 videos**, is the most comprehensive tier, with unlimited access to both the Hailuo 01 and 02 models plus the agent. Both top tiers keep video output at up to ten-second 1080p; the 2K and 4K “unlimited” perks Hailuo advertises apply to the bundled image models, not the video clips themselves.

## Conclusion
MiniMax pricing is cheap by design, whether you are generating video or calling the API. For video, the **Hailuo Standard** plan, currently **$7.99/month** on promo, is the sensible starting point, with **Pro** the upgrade most regular creators land on. For developers, **MiniMax M3** at **$0.30/$1.20 per million tokens** is the value pick for long-context work, though OpenAI’s GPT-6 Luna now costs less. The **$22 M Plan Go** tier suits anyone who wants a flat monthly bill and does not need video. Because these prices change often, and the lower Hailuo tiers are running a temporary promo, confirm the current numbers on the [**official MiniMax pricing page**](https://platform.minimax.io/docs/pricing/overview) before you subscribe.

## FAQ
**How much does MiniMax cost?**

It depends on the product. Hailuo AI video plans run from free to $199.99/month, the API charges $0.30 per million input tokens and $1.20 per million output tokens for MiniMax M3, and the developer M Plan starts at $22/month.

**Is Hailuo AI free?**

Yes, there is a free plan with limited trial credits, but it restricts you to Hailuo’s own models, keeps a watermark, and gives you the lowest queue priority. Paid plans list from $14.99/month, with a running promo currently dropping the Standard tier to $7.99.

**How many videos can I make on the Hailuo Standard plan?**

The Standard plan includes 1,000 credits, good for about 40 six-second 768p videos or roughly a dozen 1080p clips, since higher resolution burns more credits per video.

**Do Hailuo credits roll over?**

No. Subscription credits are valid for one month and expire at the end of your billing cycle, so unused credits do not carry into the next month.

**What is MiniMax M3 pricing?**

MiniMax M3 costs $0.30 per million input tokens and $1.20 output under a permanent 50% discount off its $0.60/$2.40 list rate, with prompts above 512K tokens billing at that higher tier and a 1M-token context window.

# Hailuo Pricing: Hailuo 03 Cost per Second, per Clip and per Plan (2026)
Hailuo pricing on MiniMax's API is $0.13 a second for Hailuo 03 at 2K and $0.08 at 768P, so a 5 second 2K clip costs $0.65 and a 10 second clip $1.30. This guide sets out every Hailuo price we could read on 30 October 2026: MiniMax's pay-as-you-go API, the Hailuo app's monthly and yearly plans, and the credit rates for Hailuo 03, 03 Max and Max Turbo on [Wireflow](https://wireflow.ai/), which runs all three as nodes behind one API.

The short version: MiniMax's API bills only what you render, from $0.025 a second for its lightest H3 tier at 480P up to $0.13 for Hailuo 03 at 2K. The Hailuo app is cheaper per second if you use your monthly credits, from $0.081 a second at 2K on yearly billing. The fastest draft tier, [Hailuo 03 Max Turbo](https://www.wireflow.ai/models/minimax-hailuo-03-max-turbo), has no row on MiniMax's price page, so its price depends on where you run it.

## Hailuo 03 or MiniMax H3? The names behind the prices
You buy them in two places: the [Hailuo AI](https://hailuoai.video/) app, which sells monthly credit plans, and the [MiniMax API platform](https://platform.minimax.io/), which bills per second of video.

## MiniMax API prices per second
MiniMax's API is pay as you go: you add funds, and each video is billed per second of output at the resolution you pick. For [Hailuo 03](https://www.wireflow.ai/models/minimax-hailuo-03), that is $0.13 a second at 2K. These are the rates on MiniMax's pricing page on 30 October 2026.

| Model on MiniMax's API | Resolution | Output video, per second | Input video, per second | Each extra input image |
|-|-|-|-|-|
| MiniMax-H3 (Hailuo 03) | 2K | $0.13 | $0.13 | $0.04 |
| MiniMax-H3 (Hailuo 03) | 768P | $0.08 | $0.08 | $0.04 |
| MiniMax-H3-Max (Hailuo 03 Max) | 768P | $0.08 | $0.143 | $0.074 |
| MiniMax-H3-Max (Hailuo 03 Max) | 480P | $0.05 | $0.0553 | $0.074 |
| MiniMax-H3-Highspeed | 768P | $0.06 | $0.06 | $0.03 |
| MiniMax-H3-Lite | 768P | $0.04 | $0.04 | $0.02 |
| MiniMax-H3-Lite | 480P | $0.025 | $0.025 | $0.02 |

MiniMax also sells prepaid video packages, from $1,000 for 3,760 points to $6,000 for 26,780 points, each valid for one month. The page says these "support Hailuo video models" but "MiniMax H3 is not supported yet", so Hailuo 03 runs on pay as you go only.

Older Hailuo models are still sold per video: Hailuo 2.3 costs $0.28 for a 6 second 768P clip and $0.56 for 10 seconds, and 2.3 Fast costs $0.19 and $0.32. For other places to run Hailuo, see our list of [Hailuo AI alternatives](https://www.wireflow.ai/blog/best-hailuo-ai-alternatives-in-2026).

## Hailuo 03, 03 Max and Max Turbo on credits
The node canvas from the intro hosts all three Hailuo tiers and bills them in credits. Every paid plan on its [pricing](https://www.wireflow.ai/pricing) page works out to about 1.35 cents a credit (Starter is $36 for 2,660 credits). The credits below are the board's estimates on 30 October 2026, and runs are charged for the real length.

To be plain about price: per clip, MiniMax's API and the Hailuo app both cost less. A 10 second Hailuo 03 clip at 2K is $1.30 on MiniMax's API and about $5.28 in credits, roughly four times more. Credits make sense when Hailuo is one step in a longer job, such as an image model making the first frame for an [image-to-video API](https://www.wireflow.ai/features/image-to-video-api) call, with every model on one key and one bill.

![A prompt, a GPT Image 2.5 Flare first frame (5 credits) and a 5 second Hailuo 03 clip at 2K (208 credits) on one board](https://assets.wireflow.ai/blog/hailuo-pricing/wireflow-hailuo-03-workflow.webp)

Hailuo 03 renders at 2K only, while Max and Max Turbo default to 768P, about 60% more per second than 480P. Turbo costs about half what Max does and returns a 5 second clip in a couple of seconds, so it suits drafts. To compare these rates with other video models, see our roundup of [video generation APIs](https://www.wireflow.ai/blog/best-video-generation-api-tools-in-2026).

## FAQ
### Do MiniMax's video packages cover Hailuo 03?
Not yet. MiniMax's packages, from $1,000 for 3,760 points, cover older Hailuo models such as 2.3 and 02. The page says "MiniMax H3 is not supported yet", so Hailuo 03 runs on pay as you go.

### Can I call Hailuo 03 from code alongside other models?
Yes. MiniMax's API covers MiniMax's own models.

## Conclusion
Hailuo pricing comes down to seconds: $0.13 a second for Hailuo 03 at 2K on MiniMax's API, as little as $0.081 in the Hailuo app if you use a yearly plan's credits, and $0.025 to $0.08 for the lighter H3 tiers. Pick the app if you will use a monthly allowance, MiniMax's API if your volume changes month to month, and Wireflow if Hailuo is one node in a longer job with other models, starting from the [AI video generator](https://www.wireflow.ai/ai-video-generator).
